stock_import_runs_compaction_check.name: stock_import_runs_compaction_check
stock_import_runs_compaction_check.value: ("stock_import_runs"."raw_snapshot_compacted_at" is null and "stock_import_runs"."raw_snapshot" is not null) or ("stock_import_runs"."raw_snapshot_compacted_at" is not null and "stock_import_runs"."status" = 'completed' and "stock_import_runs"."payload_hash" is not null and "stock_import_runs"."raw_snapshot" is null)

vehicles_nonnegative_values_check.name: vehicles_nonnegative_values_check
vehicles_nonnegative_values_check.value:
("vehicles"."source_price" is null or "vehicles"."source_price" >= 0)
         and ("vehicles"."pending_source_price" is null or "vehicles"."pending_source_price" >= 0)
        and ("vehicles"."website_price_override" is null or "vehicles"."website_price_override" >= 0)
        and ("vehicles"."mileage" is null or "vehicles"."mileage" >= 0)
        and ("vehicles"."image_count" is null or "vehicles"."image_count" >= 0)
        and "vehicles"."missing_count" >= 0

enquiries_archive_dates_check.name: enquiries_archive_dates_check
enquiries_archive_dates_check.value: ("enquiries"."archived_at" is null and "enquiries"."archive_delete_at" is null and "enquiries"."archive_review_at" is null and "enquiries"."archive_hold_reason" is null) or ("enquiries"."archived_at" is not null and "enquiries"."archive_delete_at" is not null and "enquiries"."archive_delete_at" >= "enquiries"."archived_at")

leads_closure_check.name: leads_closure_check
leads_closure_check.value:
(
        "leads"."stage" in ('won', 'lost')
        and "leads"."outcome" is not null
        and "leads"."outcome"::text = "leads"."stage"::text
        and "leads"."outcome_reason" is not null
        and length(btrim("leads"."outcome_reason")) > 0
        and "leads"."closed_at" is not null
      ) or (
        "leads"."stage" not in ('won', 'lost')
        and "leads"."outcome" is null
        and "leads"."outcome_reason" is null
        and "leads"."closed_at" is null
      )

leads_deposit_check.name: leads_deposit_check
leads_deposit_check.value:
(
        "leads"."deposit_pence" = 0
        and "leads"."deposit_method" is null
        and "leads"."deposit_taken_at" is null
      ) or (
        "leads"."deposit_pence" > 0
        and "leads"."deposit_method" is not null
        and "leads"."deposit_taken_at" is not null
      )

stock_change_customer_outcomes_values_ch.name: stock_change_customer_outcomes_values_check
stock_change_customer_outcomes_values_ch.value: "stock_change_customer_outcomes"."status" in ('pending','contacted','not_needed','follow_up') and "stock_change_customer_outcomes"."revision">=0 and ("stock_change_customer_outcomes"."channel" is null or "stock_change_customer_outcomes"."channel" in ('call','email','whatsapp')) and (("stock_change_customer_outcomes"."status"='follow_up' and "stock_change_customer_outcomes"."follow_up_at" is not null) or ("stock_change_customer_outcomes"."status"<>'follow_up' and "stock_change_customer_outcomes"."follow_up_at" is null))

stock_change_settings_values_check.name: stock_change_settings_values_check
stock_change_settings_values_check.value: "stock_change_settings"."minimum_reduction" between 0 and 1000000 and "stock_change_settings"."contact_interval_days" between 0 and 365 and "stock_change_settings"."revision" >= 0

cazoo_feed_checks_count_check.name: cazoo_feed_checks_count_check
cazoo_feed_checks_count_check.value: ("cazoo_feed_checks"."vehicle_count" is null or "cazoo_feed_checks"."vehicle_count" >= 0) and ("cazoo_feed_checks"."file_bytes" is null or "cazoo_feed_checks"."file_bytes" >= 0)

cazoo_customer_reply_forwards_payload_ch.name: cazoo_customer_reply_forwards_payload_check
cazoo_customer_reply_forwards_payload_ch.value: ("cazoo_customer_reply_forwards"."payload" is null and "cazoo_customer_reply_forwards"."payload_hash" is null and "cazoo_customer_reply_forwards"."account_hash" is null) or ("cazoo_customer_reply_forwards"."payload" is not null and "cazoo_customer_reply_forwards"."payload_hash" is not null and "cazoo_customer_reply_forwards"."account_hash" is not null)

cazoo_forwarding_recipient_check.name: cazoo_forwarding_recipient_check
cazoo_forwarding_recipient_check.value: ("cazoo_lead_forwarding_settings"."recipient" is null or length("cazoo_lead_forwarding_settings"."recipient") between 3 and 254) and (not "cazoo_lead_forwarding_settings"."enabled" or "cazoo_lead_forwarding_settings"."recipient" is not null)

cazoo_lead_forwards_payload_check.name: cazoo_lead_forwards_payload_check
cazoo_lead_forwards_payload_check.value: ("cazoo_lead_forwards"."payload" is null and "cazoo_lead_forwards"."payload_hash" is null and "cazoo_lead_forwards"."account_hash" is null) or ("cazoo_lead_forwards"."payload" is not null and "cazoo_lead_forwards"."payload_hash" is not null and "cazoo_lead_forwards"."account_hash" is not null)

stock_alerts_due_idx.name: stock_alerts_due_idx
stock_alerts_due_idx.where: "stock_alerts"."unsubscribed_at" is null and "stock_alerts"."confirmed_at" is not null
